The START Network

We’re part of the international START Network, which includes many chapters across Europe and South America. This connection allows us to exchange knowledge, collaborate internationally, and give our members access to the broader entrepreneurial ecosystem. Through the network, members can engage with a wide range of peers, attend international events like the START Summit, and gain insights from different regional startup environments.
